title: The Choice of the Heavenly Eye
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the dimensional rift fully closed, the core forbidden artifact in Chen Ji's palm, whose warmth had been fading, suddenly burst forth with unprecedented light—this was not an ending, but the beginning of a complete reshaping of the Three Realms' landscape.

text.content: In the depths of the dimensional rift, the heart-stopping fluctuations grew increasingly violent. The void was being torn as if by an invisible giant hand, and within the tearing sounds came a low-frequency hum beyond human comprehension—the presence of the invader's true form, descending through the void at a speed surpassing light by multiples.

At this critical moment, a gentle yet vast will emerged from the void. Not oppression, but the embracing compassion like amniotic fluid protecting all life. Chen Ji's Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burned hot, and the will he had long sought finally manifested completely—the Heavenly Eye.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji... I've been waiting for you." The voice was ancient yet serene, like an old well that had witnessed countless vicissitudes. "Or more precisely, I've been waiting for someone who could bear this weight, for a very, very long time."

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the massive eye slowly opening in the void, within which the weight of ten thousand years swirled. When Chen Ji's figure appeared reflected in those depths, a sense of approval flickered within the eye. "The inheritor of the Tianji Record... you have not disappointed me."

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Eye, venerable elder." Chen Ji clasped his hands and bowed, his voice steady despite the turmoil within. "Disciple has always wished to know—what manner of existence are you? Why are you imprisoned here? And why have you chosen disciple?"

text.content: The smile faded from the Heavenly Eye, replaced by a sorrow so profound it reached the extreme. "I am a deserter from a higher dimension." These words struck like thunder within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "Ten thousand years ago, I betrayed my kin and chose to protect the integrity of the three-dimensional world."

"The invaders from higher dimensions wished to absorb the three-dimensional universe into their domain. I was the sole dissenter." A hint of bitterness laced the Heavenly Eye's voice. "Thus I was stripped of everything, imprisoned here, becoming the final firewall protecting the three dimensions—using my own existence to repel each invasion."

dialogue.content: "This invader..." Chen Ji turned toward the dimensional rift, where the oppressive force had become tangible.

"My former kin." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried no波动. "The ten-thousand-year imprisonment nears its end, not because I have gained freedom, but because my lamp has run dry and oil spent—each time I repelled an invasion, I consumed my own origin."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart seized with sudden tightness. He finally understood—this being before him had been safeguarding the Three Realms at the cost of its very life. Ten thousand years! What an eternity of torment! Every day a desperate struggle against the invaders, every moment drawing closer to death.

dialogue.content: "Elder..." Chen Ji's voice grew hoarse. "Is there truly no other method? Disciple could—"

"Say no more." The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly softened. "I have awaited this day for a very long time. The millennium of guardianship draws to a close, and you—yes, you are the one I have been waiting for." That massive eye turned toward Chen Ji, filled with approval and anticipation.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye stands poised to make its final choice—this existence that has guarded the three-dimensional world for ten thousand years chooses to entrust its hope to you. How will you respond to this weighty commission?

choices.description: Respect the Heavenly Eye's choice, take up the responsibility it bequeaths, and continue the sacred mission of guarding the Three Realms
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Observer Authority and Final Forbidden Artifact granted by the Heavenly Eye

dialogue.content: "Disciple... accepts the mission." Chen Ji knelt on one knee, his voice low yet resolute. "Your ten-thousand-year vigil, elder, disciple shall forever remember. The safety of the Three Realms—Chen Ji shall bear it on his shoulders alone!"

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's radiance blazed with sudden brilliance, and within that ancient will emerged a smile of deep satisfaction. "Good... very good." It spoke slowly. "Now I shall grant you—the Observer Authority sealed for ten thousand years."

choices.description: Attempt to find other methods to extend the Heavenly Eye's existence
choices.risk_hint: Time is running out, the invaders are coming

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a flicker of unwillingness flashing in his eyes. "Ten thousand years of guardianship should not end like this! There must be a way—there must be!"

The Heavenly Eyes fell silent for a moment, and within that ancient will, a trace of bitter laughter actually stirred. "Chen Ji, I understand your intentions. But some things cannot be changed by effort alone." Its voice carried a hint of weariness. "I have waited too long, and I am far too tired."

text.content: Just then, a sharp shriek echoed from the dimensional rift—the invaders' presence was now close at hand. Chen Ji knew that time was running out.

choices.description: Using the power of the Tianji Record to attempt retaining the Heavenly Eyes
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate, may backfire
choices.visible_reward: If successful, can delay the dissipation of the Heavenly Eyes
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Heavenly Eyes, and success is not guaranteed

dialogue.content: "No!" Chen Ji strode forward abruptly, the Tianji Record Fragment burning in his palm. "This disciple refuses to accept such an ending! Tianji Record—grant me the power to reverse time!"

"Silly child." The Heavenly Eyes' voice suddenly turned stern. "If you forcibly retain me, you will only shorten your own lifespan. Besides—" Its great eye gazed intently at Chen Ji. "My dissipation is the key to opening a new situation."

text.content: A gentle yet irresistible force sent Chen Ji staggering backward several steps. He finally understood that some choices, from the very beginning, were beyond his interference.

Chen Ji fell into a long silence. When he spoke again, his voice had returned to its usual calm, but beneath that calm lay the weight of ten thousand jun. "This disciple understands. Please rest assured, senior—this disciple will not fail your trust."

dialogue.content: "Excellent." The Heavenly Eyes' radiance began to surge, layer upon layer of seals peeling away from its will. "Now, accept my final gift—the Observer's Authority sealed for ten thousand years. From this moment forward, you shall possess eyes that can gaze directly upon the source of karma and cause."

text.content: An unprecedented power surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It was a vision surpassing even the Tianji Record Fragment—the causal rhythms of all creation's operation, the flow of天地Spiritual Energy, even the fractures between the invaders and Heavenly Dao's laws—all clearly presented before his eyes.

dialogue.content: "There is also this." The Heavenly Eyes' voice gradually grew feeble, the great eye's radiance beginning to dim. A core forbidden artifact emanating gentle warmth materialized from the Void, drifting slowly toward Chen Ji. "This is my final source crystal—it can temporarily sever four-dimensional connections."

text.content: Chen Ji extended both hands, solemnly accepting that core forbidden artifact. When his fingertips touched its warm surface, a powerful force surged into his body—the accumulated will-force from the Heavenly Eyes' ten thousand years of guardianship, the prayers of countless saints for the three realms.

dialogue.content: "Senior!" Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, watching the great eye's radiance fading rapidly. Ten thousand years of imprisonment, ten thousand years of guardianship, ten thousand years of solitude... Now, finally, it was time to draw the final line.

"Chen Ji..." The Heavenly Eyes' voice flickered like a candle in the wind, on the verge of extinguishing. "Watch over the three realms for me. This is... my final wish." That last glimmer in those great eyes gazed at Chen Ji, full of reluctance and hope.

"Senior!" Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. This man who had schemed an entire lifetime, who had never let anyone see his vulnerability, finally shed all pretense in this moment. "This disciple... will not disappoint!"

text.content: The Heavenly Eyes' great eye finally closed slowly. As it dissipated, that ancient will actually carried a hint of relieved laughter—"Finally... I can rest."

The moment the Heavenly Eyes completely vanished, the entire dimensional rift quivered. The protective force that had enveloped the three realms for ten thousand years receded like a tide, replaced by an unprecedented clarity. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment resonating thunderously within his Mental Sea—at this moment, his connection with Heavenly Dao had crossed dimensional barriers.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood quietly in the Void, his hand tightly gripping the core forbidden artifact that still retained its warmth. After a long while, he deeply bowed toward the direction where the Heavenly Eyes had vanished, his voice low but resolute: "Senior, farewell. The three realms are in my hands."

text.content: Within the dimensional rift, the invaders' presence drew ever closer. But at this moment, Chen Ji's eyes held not a trace of fear. The Observer's Authority operated within his Mental Sea, and the source crystal radiated gentle warmth in his palm. He finally understood—this was merely the beginning—the chess game of the three realms, from this day forward, would be played with him as the Chess Player.
